title: Inspect listening sockets with ss
summary: Use ss to verify which TCP and UDP ports are listening and which processes own them.
explanation: ss reads kernel socket information. Numeric output avoids slow name resolution, while process details help connect a port to the service that opened it.
use_case: An API should be listening on port 8080; confirm that it started and identify its process.
question: How can you identify the process listening on TCP or UDP port 8080?
